model.name: MiniMax H3 pi-H3 World 20B (Experimental)
model.description: An explorable walk through a scene described in text (or starting from an image), with its sound, made about 4 seconds per move: forward, backward, left, right or a typed event, each move continuing the last one without a cut. It runs on the 2-step pi-H3 model, close to real time at 480p on a fast GPU; it only remembers the last second of video, and the text decides how far each move goes.

prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A first-person walk along a narrow cobblestone street of an old Mediterranean town at golden hour, whitewashed houses with blue shutters, flower pots and hanging laundry, warm low sunlight and long shadows.
overall_soundscape: Footsteps on stones, distant chatter, swallows and a faint church bell.
